title: His Name Is John
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: At last Elisabeth had her baby, a little boy! Family and neighbors heard how kind Heavenly Father had been, and they were glad.
On his eighth day, it was time to name him. Everyone said, “Call him Zacharias, like his father.” But Elisabeth said, “No. His name is John.”
The people were puzzled. “Nobody in your family has that name!” They made signs to ask Zacharias.
p2: He still could not talk. So he wrote on a little board, “His name is John.” Right then, he could talk again! He praised Heavenly Father. Everyone wondered what this child would grow up to be.
Zacharias obeyed the angel, and his voice came back. Tonight, use your voice to say something kind to your family.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
